A1.justification: Both 10-page PDFs describe the same VEMamba work, with readable text, equations, three tables, seven figures and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction experiments on EPFL and CREMI, downstream mitochondria segmentation, and component ablations in Section 4.

after.justification: v2 retains these original reconstruction, segmentation and ablation results in Section 4.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.4 retain the same architecture, ALCSSM scanning, DWAM aggregation, MoCo degradation learning, VDIM, reconstruction procedure and losses.

E1.justification: Both versions use EPFL and CREMI for reconstruction and EPFL for mitochondria segmentation. Synthetic degradation on EPFL and lateral-plane evaluation on CREMI are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 2 retain interpolation, IsoVEM and EMDiffuse as comparators. The isotropic reference in the segmentation comparison also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain the same reconstruction factors, input dimensions, training settings, baseline retraining procedure and segmentation protocol. PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and IoU remain the evaluation metrics.

E4.justification: Section 4.4, Table 3 and Figure 6 retain the same ALCSSM, DWAM and MoCo ablations and axial pixel-error analysis. The qualitative reconstruction and segmentation comparisons are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty reporting is added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 1 changes VEMamba's EPFL ×4 PSNR from 29.422 to 29.442 dB under unchanged reported settings, matching the value already present in Table 3. Other scores, rankings and qualitative results are unchanged; no experimental rerun is documented.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(6), their definitions and associated mathematical descriptions are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about Mamba-based reconstruction, axial-lateral consistency, degradation learning, reconstruction quality and computational efficiency.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and interpretations of reconstruction, segmentation and ablation results remain identical. The qualification about applying RGB-pretrained LPIPS to grayscale microscopy is retained, with no new limitations.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility disclosures are unchanged, including PyTorch, two RTX 4090 GPUs, optimizer and training settings, model configuration, degradation-setting attribution and the source-code URL.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning and all 41 cited works are unchanged. Removing reference-list back-reference page numbers does not alter citation membership or relationships to prior work.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp is updated, and bibliography back-reference page numbers and PDF navigation bookmarks are removed. The scientific prose, terminology and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Blue citation and cross-reference text becomes black, and internal links and bibliography back-links are removed. Figures 1–7 and all table structures, captions and placements remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Changing Table 1 to 29.442 dB resolves its inconsistency with the unchanged full-model result in Table 3, providing a small improvement in reporting consistency without changing rankings. Scientific content and support otherwise remain stable. Removal of internal links and bookmarks slightly reduces navigation convenience, but the numerical consistency correction provides a limited net benefit.
